title: Accounts assistant
description:
The Business
We're partnering with a successful international engineering business with a strong reputation for innovation, quality and operational excellence. As the company continues to grow, they are looking to strengthen their finance team with the appointment of a Sales & Purchase Ledger Assistant at their Liverpool City Centre office.
This is a varied and hands-on opportunity for someone who enjoys the day-to-day mechanics of finance, takes ownership of their work and wants to be part of a stable business where they can make a real contribution to the team.

The Role
Reporting to the Management Accountant, this is a varied and hands-on role that would suit someone who enjoys the operational side of finance and takes pride in delivering accurate, high-quality work. You'll play a key role in the day-to-day running of both the sales and purchase ledger functions, supporting the wider finance team and ensuring processes run smoothly and efficiently.
This opportunity is ideal for a practical, proactive individual who enjoys getting stuck in, taking ownership of their workload and contributing to the success of the wider team.
Duties includes:
- Managing the sales and purchase ledger processes from start to finish.
- Processing supplier invoices across multiple finance systems.
- Raising and issuing customer invoices accurately and on time.
- Obtaining approval for payments from relevant stakeholders.
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving any discrepancies.
- Supporting month-end close activities and producing ledger reports.
- Assisting with credit control activities where required.
- Processing company credit card transactions and VAT-related entries.
- Setting up new suppliers and maintaining supplier records.
- Managing intercompany invoicing and reconciliations.
- Performing regular bank reconciliations.

Person
- Previous experience within a finance, accounts, sales ledger or purchase ledger position.
- Strong IT skills including experience using finance systems.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
- Able to work independently and as part of a team.
- Organised, reliable and able to manage multiple tasks effectively.
- Positive attitude with a willingness to take ownership and get things done.

Benefits
- Salary up to £30k DOE
- 36-hour working week with hybrid working and flexible working
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Company pension scheme with generous employer contributions.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Liverpool
Salary: £28,000 per annum + Paid Study Support + Salary Increase with Exam Passes
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 4:00pm

About the Role

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an ambitious and driven Accounts Assistant to join a well-established accountancy practice based in Liverpool. Supporting a varied portfolio of SME clients, you will gain hands-on experience across accounts preparation, bookkeeping and client support while studying towards a professional qualification.

This role is ideal for someone seeking long-term career development within practice, offering fully paid study support, salary increases linked to exam success, and a clear progression pathway.

Key Responsibilities
- Preparing year-end accounts for sole traders, partnerships and limited companies
- Assisting with the preparation of management accounts
- Completing bookkeeping duties using cloud-based accounting software
- Preparing and submitting VAT returns
- Liaising directly with clients to obtain financial information and resolve queries
- Supporting senior team members with client accounts assignments
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client records
- Assisting with general practice administration where required

About You
- Previous experience within an accountancy practice environment is essential
- AAT qualified, studying AAT, or looking to begin professional studies
- Strong communication and organisational skills
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and accounting software
- Keen to develop a long-term career within accountancy practice
- Able to manage workloads effectively and meet deadlines

What's on Offer?

Starting salary of £28,000

Fully paid study support towards AAT, ACCA or ACA qualifications

Salary increases upon successful exam passes

28 days annual leave plus bank holidays

Additional annual leave awarded with length of service

Early finish every day with 8:30am - 4:00pm working hours

Supportive and collaborative team environment

Clear progression opportunities within the practice

Exposure to a broad range of SME clients across various sectors

This is a fantastic opportunity for an Accounts Assistant looking to develop their technical skills, progress professionally, and build a successful career within a supportive and growing accountancy practice.

If this sounds like your next opportunity, apply here or contact Liz Chapman at Reed today.

title: Trade Marketing Manager
description:
Trade Marketing Manager Retail Competitive Salary

We are partnering with an established consumer brand to recruit a Trade Marketing Manager to lead the planning and delivery of campaigns across its wholesale and retail network.

This is a commercially focused marketing role, working across brand, retail, wholesale and digital channels to bring campaigns, product launches and seasonal activity to life. The Trade Marketing Manager will play an important role in strengthening retail presence, supporting wholesale partners and ensuring customers experience a consistent and engaging brand proposition across every touchpoint.

The role would suit a creative and commercially minded marketer who understands how brands operate in a retail environment and can take campaigns from strategy and planning through to execution and measurement.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver trade marketing plans aligned to wider brand and commercial objectives.
- Lead integrated campaigns across wholesale, retail and digital channels, from initial concept through to execution.
- Work closely with wholesale partners to develop effective retail marketing activity that drives visibility, engagement and sales.
- Plan and deliver seasonal campaigns, product launches and key commercial initiatives.
- Develop and manage retail marketing assets including POS, in-store displays, promotional materials and digital content.
- Partner with internal teams across Brand, Ecommerce, Sales and Product to ensure campaigns are aligned and delivered effectively.
- Support the development of customer-facing content across social media, email and other digital channels.
- Use customer, market and competitor insight to identify opportunities and inform campaign planning.
- Manage campaign timelines, budgets, agencies and external partners where required.
- Monitor campaign performance and commercial results, using data and insight to identify opportunities for optimisation.
- Ensure all trade marketing activity is delivered consistently and in line with brand guidelines.
- Keep up to date with retail, consumer and marketing trends to identify new opportunities for the brand and its retail partners.

Key Requirements
- Proven experience in trade marketing, retail marketing or a closely related consumer marketing role.
- Experience working within a retail, consumer, wholesale or D2 C environment.
- Strong understanding of the retail customer journey and how marketing activity can influence awareness, engagement and sales.
- Experience delivering integrated campaigns across physical and digital channels.
- Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
- Commercially aware, with confidence using campaign and sales data to assess performance and make recommendations.
- Experience working with wholesale partners, retailers, agencies or external stakeholders would be beneficial.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing channels including social media, email and online content.
- Creative thinker who can develop ideas but is equally comfortable managing the detail required to deliver them.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Highly organised, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
- A degree in Marketing, Business or a related discipline would be beneficial, although relevant industry experience will be equally valued.

This is a strong opportunity for an experienced Trade Marketing Manager to take ownership of a broad retail marketing remit, working across campaigns, launches, wholesale partnerships and customer engagement within an established consumer business.

If you are a commercially minded Trade Marketing Manager who enjoys combining creative campaign development with hands-on delivery and measurable results, we'd love to hear from you.
